tutor.label: Tutor
tutor.explain: At this step AI works as a tutor. It explains and coaches. The team still does the thinking.

build.label: Co-builder
build.explain: AI can act as a co-builder here, and as a tutor. It is allowed only if the learner reviews and edits the result and can explain it.

own.label: Own work
own.explain: AI may not be the author here. The research, pitch or plan must be the team's own work. AI can still act as a tutor.

partner.yesLong: The community partner is brought in at this step.
partner.noLong: The team works on its own, with the facilitator.

facilitatorDefault: Guides the team and plans the cycle.

steps.title: Find the need
steps.what: Talk to the people affected and a community partner.

steps.title: Research feasibility
steps.what: Check whether the problem is real, big enough and doable by this team.

facilitator.text: Decides: go on, redesign or stop.

steps.title: Design
steps.what: Shape the chosen idea and how it will be used.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.what: Put it in front of real users.

facilitator.text: Signs off safety with the Do-No-Harm Check.

steps.title: Pitch
steps.what: Explain the solution and its business case to the partner and a panel.

steps.title: Sustain
steps.what: Plan who owns it, how it is paid for and how it keeps working.
